criterion: A budget is relevant when an experienced estimator would use it as a reference for at least one main deliverable of the project: comparable functional scope at component level. Same sector or same technology alone is not enough. Annotated by hand before running any configuration.

queries.query: Online store for a gourmet food shop: product catalog, shopping cart and checkout with card payments, a customer loyalty program and order confirmation emails.
queries.notes: 005 storefront, catalog and checkout; 006 order management and refunds; 007 food retail with inventory sync. 003 (payments gateway) is the expected distractor: a shop integrates a payment provider, it does not build one.

queries.query: Telehealth app for a network of clinics that integrates with hospital EHRs over HL7 FHIR, books video consultations and records patient consent.
queries.notes: 009 matches almost every deliverable; 010 patient-facing clinical data and care team flows. Exact identifiers (HL7, FHIR) favour the lexical branch.

queries.query: We want our lenders to decide automatically whether to approve credit requests from small businesses, and clients should be able to sign the contract digitally.
queries.notes: 002 credit scoring, origination and e-signature; 004 client onboarding and risk profiling. Paraphrased on purpose: few literal terms shared with the corpus.

queries.query: Platform that collects readings from thousands of sensors on our production lines, warns the maintenance team before machines fail and shows dashboards to plant operators.
queries.notes: 013 is the direct match; 015 high-volume meter data pipeline and forecasting; 010 device data ingestion plus alerting engine, relevant despite the different sector.

queries.query: Logistics app to plan delivery routes for our van fleet, let customers choose delivery time windows and track warehouse stock in real time.
queries.notes: 007 slot booking, route optimisation and inventory sync; 014 warehouse management and dock scheduling.
